claude-memory.name: Claude Code built-in memory
claude-memory.same: The "remember my project" convenience, in markdown.
gain: The same memory in Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and 20 more
Synced across your machines
Shared with your team
Real search, and capture of what the tools actually did
claude-memory.theyWin: Zero setup. It is already on, and there is no server to run. For one developer on one machine who only uses Claude Code, it may be all you need.
claude-memory.verdict: Move when you add a second agent, a second machine or a second person.

mem0.name: Mem0 and LangMem
gain: Readable pages you can open and edit, in place of opaque fact rows
Search that fuses full text, entities, links and vectors
No API spend to capture or search
mem0.theyWin: A large SDK ecosystem and a managed cloud built for personalizing apps for end users.
mem0.verdict: Different buyer. Mem0 remembers your app’s users. ai-memory remembers your repository.

zep.name: Zep and Graphiti
zep.same: Facts are superseded, never deleted. You can ask what was true at a point in time.
gain: Point-in-time queries and typed links on one binary with SQLite
No graph database to run
Native to coding agents, with hooks for 20+ of them
zep.theyWin: True bi-temporal modelling, Cypher graph queries and custom entity types. ai-memory tracks ingestion time only, by design.
zep.verdict: Move if you self-host for coding. Stay if you need enterprise graph queries.

cognee.name: cognee
cognee.same: Provenance, feedback-weighted ranking and a Claude Code plugin.
gain: One store to back up: a folder of markdown
No LLM bill for ingestion
A single binary that runs on a homelab box
cognee.theyWin: Breadth: 14+ retrieval modes, ontology grounding, and ingestion of PDFs, CSVs and web pages.
cognee.verdict: Move if you want memory for coding sessions. Stay if you ingest documents.

openviking.name: OpenViking and Hindsight
openviking.same: Memory compiled into living pages by a background consolidation loop.
gain: Capture, search and handoffs with zero LLM calls
Files you own, MIT licensed, no AGPL or SaaS weight
Team sharing per project in place of strict per-bank isolation
openviking.theyWin: Higher reported accuracy with an LLM in the loop: Hindsight reports 91.4% on LongMemEval, OpenViking reports large token savings. Both are vendor numbers.
openviking.verdict: Move for self-hosted, offline or team use. Stay if you need their accuracy and accept the LLM requirement.

basic-memory.name: basic-memory
basic-memory.same: Markdown on disk is the source of truth, with a derived index.
gain: Automatic capture from lifecycle hooks
Decay and supersession, so stale notes stop ranking
Cross-agent handoffs and multi-user sharing
basic-memory.theyWin: A local cross-encoder reranker, real-time collaborative editing and a hosted mobile app.
basic-memory.verdict: Move for multi-agent coding continuity. Stay for a personal Obsidian-style knowledge base.

mcp-memory-service.name: mcp-memory-service
mcp-memory-service.same: SQLite, local embeddings, hook capture, typed links and honest numbers.
gain: Pages you can read in place of fact rows
Claim-once handoffs between agents
Cross-project messaging and point-in-time search
mcp-memory-service.theyWin: Clustering-based consolidation, multi-backend replication and a graph visualizer. Its session-level score of 0.860 is above ai-memory’s 0.823.
mcp-memory-service.verdict: Move if you liked hook capture and want it across every agent.

agentmemory.name: agentmemory
agentmemory.same: Nearly every concept: tiers, supersession, decay, fused ranking, hooks.
gain: One self-contained binary with no sidecar
Real SQL indexes committed in one transaction
Files as the source of truth, Windows parity, fuller auth
agentmemory.theyWin: About 13 points of raw retrieval: it reports 0.952 on LongMemEval-S against 0.823, because it reranks. It also has peer-to-peer sync.
agentmemory.verdict: Move for operability and data ownership.

letta.name: Letta and MemGPT
letta.same: Memory tiers and consolidation off the hot path.
gain: Memory that sits under the agent you already use
No runtime to adopt, no tokens spent on self-editing
letta.theyWin: A full agent framework and development environment, with strong long-horizon coherence.
letta.verdict: Stay if you build on Letta. Move if you only want your coding agent to remember.

supermemory.name: Supermemory
supermemory.same: A second brain with automatic ingestion and supersession.
gain: Git-versioned markdown you own
Works offline
Scoped to your repository, where Supermemory is a general vault
supermemory.theyWin: Managed connectors for Drive, Gmail, Notion and S3, multimodal ingestion and user profiles.

moat.title: Zero LLM calls by default
moat.text: Capture, search and handoffs work with no API key.

moat.title: Files are the source of truth
moat.text: A git-backed folder of markdown. The database is a rebuildable index.

moat.title: One self-contained binary
moat.text: It runs without a graph database, a Python runtime or a sidecar process.

moat.title: Typed, claim-once handoffs
moat.text: A protocol: each handoff has a type and an owner, and only one session can claim it.

moat.title: Teams without a paid tier
moat.text: Accounts, attribution and an audit log are in the box.
